miniProject.title: Bounded async worker pipeline with overload, cancellation, telemetry and a container runbook
miniProject.brief: Give the task runner an execution engine: a bounded async pipeline with deadlines, retries, telemetry and a container runbook. Profile it honestly and make every failure visible through signals another reader can follow.
steps: Compare matched CPU work across serial, thread and process modes on the available Python builds, including a free-threaded one where available, then show an event-loop blocking fault and its move off the loop.

Build the bounded pipeline with `TaskGroup` workers that rejects excess work, drains on shutdown and reports abandoned work instead of success when the drain expires, following the AlgoMaster Bounded Buffer problem.
Run each task under a monotonic deadline with classified retries, jittered backoff and cancellation cleanup, tested against a fault-injected dependency that fails then succeeds.
Profile a large batch for the hot spot and retained memory, fix one cause, then benchmark the improvement without the profiler and record one rejected optimization with its numbers.
Instrument runs with spans, queue-wait children, JSON logs and bounded-label counters, exclude secrets from every signal, and locate one seeded failure from the signals alone.
Ship a non-root bounded container with liveness and readiness gates, exercise the dependency outage and `SIGTERM` drain, and write a runbook a second reader follows to recovery.
deliverables: The pipeline with overload, shutdown, deadline, retry and cancellation tests plus the executor timings.
A profiling note with the hot spot, the retention fix, the benchmark and the rejected optimization.
Telemetry tests, the container definition and the exercised runbook with outage and drain transcripts.

rubric.pass: The overload test rejects excess work, and every accepted run ends recorded or is reported abandoned.
rubric.strong: Executor choices cite the matched-work timings, and the blocking fault shows the stalled and advancing heartbeat.

rubric.pass: No retry follows permanent failure, an exhausted budget, an expired deadline or cancellation, and no worker outlives its owner.
rubric.strong: Backoff bounds are tested without wall-clock waits, and an idempotency note covers already-applied retries.

rubric.pass: The hot spot and retention site come from profiler output, and the kept improvement has unprofiled trials.
rubric.strong: The note states the workload region where the gain holds and why the rejected optimization lost.

rubric.pass: Parent and trace ids agree across the queue, metrics carry only bounded labels, and secrets appear in no signal.
rubric.strong: The seeded failure is traced from a metric to a span to a log line without added prints.

rubric.pass: The container runs non-root under its limits, survives the outage without a restart, and drains on `SIGTERM`.
rubric.strong: A second reader followed the runbook to recovery, and the steps they found unclear were fixed.

miniProject.feedsInto: The bounded pipeline with backpressure, cancellation and telemetry, the injected outage and the clean-checkout runbook for the capstone.
